statement: theorem regret_fixed_coarse (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (T : ℕ) (hloss : ∀ t < T, SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t)) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) : regret V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ u T ≤ ‖x₁ - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) + η / 2 * (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖currentSubgradient (loss t) (iterate V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ t)‖ ^ 2)
